source_model: Exact row-normalized integer weights in the frozen Q24 fixture; not the original expm or continuum PDE.
publication_requirement: Publish and read back all new source/protocol files before generating formal tapes. Record the immutable commit SHA. The original pure-Q24 strict failures remain unchanged.
interval_rounding: ROUND_FLOOR for lower bounds and ROUND_CEILING for upper bounds; interval Bayes divides lower numerator by upper total and upper numerator by lower total; probability-simplex intersection preserves enclosure.
replay_rule: On the frozen native engine's precision refusal, advance the trusted interval cache over the already consumed public buffer and exactly the next refused event. Requantize the enclosed posterior with a calculated integer L1 certificate, then resume after that event. No future event, hidden label, epsilon repair, action drop, retry with different observation or resampling is permitted.
cache_rule: The cache stores all lower/upper probability bounds, structural support, model identity, precision, event cursor and integer clock. Replay each consumed event once in sequence, including final audit of any residual buffer.
error_rule: Rebase and every native update must obey the unchanged 167772-unit bound. A failed interval positivity or precision check aborts rather than relaxing precision or silently widening the contract.
quality_numeric_threshold: Maximum original float64 finite-model L1 error <1e-4; descriptive comparison only, independently of the exact-fixture interval proof.
recovery_test: Stop after floor(549/2)=274 events, write complete native+interval cache bundle, resume in a separate process against the same full tape, require identical per-event state and final native checkpoint plus interval cache. Verify cumulative replay count.
evidence_integrity: Refuse every existing output namespace; retain all partial and failed attempts. Full raw file bytes are indexed and archived in <=480000-byte compressed parts.
cost_accounting: Record compiler/unit tests/full execution/prefix/restart/rejections separately with external process CPU receipts. External driver CPU includes waited-for native descendants; replay and native component clocks overlap and must not be added again. Cache/checkpoint/tape/artifact bytes are recorded. The checkpoint's cumulative CPU fields are snapshots and lower bounds; complete process costs use outer receipts.
history_scope: The complete supplied public tape is retained and bound by its hash. Constant-history or unbounded-stream resource safety is not claimed.
security_scope: Trusted snapshot corruption checks and identity binding; no authentication or anti-rollback.
